stem.en: Put the Ledger's lines in the order they were written, and read them as one sentence.

text.en: Flame and seed are made of the same few atoms.
The same bonding rules hold both together.
Both run the same reaction, downhill: fuel and oxygen, same equation, same energy.
The seed is built of carbon molecules with exact shapes, and no vital force is needed to make them.
The seed has a wall, and burns in tiny steps behind it, catching energy as coins.
The seed carries a tape and reads it with a machine made of tape.
The seed's cells sense and signal, with receptors they built from the tape.
The seed copies its tape with small errors, so its kind changes.
It is the loop: the tape builds the machines, the machines catch energy, the energy keeps the wall and copies the tape.

image.alt: Nine ledger-line fragments scattered on a table waiting to be arranged in order into one complete sentence, each a small notebook clipping.
